operator.name: F_R
operator.interpretation: Restrict a basis-structural skeleton to an explicitly witnessed basis subobject R.

allowed_actions: forget structural edges incident to a forgotten coordinate
forget an explicitly selected structural edge without rewiring the retained graph
forget an explicitly selected temporal feature
forget an explicitly selected P/Q/Pi/C control-state feature
forbidden_actions: rewire an edge to different retained nodes
inspect construct labels or desired Archetype membership
common_image_rule: A candidate Archetype A must be structurally isomorphic to an F_R image of every claimed member.
maximality_rule: If a strictly richer common basis subobject A_prime exists for the same member set, A alone is not accepted as a maximal Archetype.
nontriviality_rule: Generic one-node/no-relation collapses are rejected. Stronger domain-independent nontriviality criteria may be added only before real-corpus outcomes are inspected.
multiple_maxima: Retain multiple incomparable maximal common basis subobjects; do not force a unique meet.
frozen_phi_boundary: No #225 Phi object or frozen 1770-pair relation is modified.
